data.title: General & Laparoscopic Surgery in Kochi
data.excerpt: Kinder Hospital's Department of General & Minimally Invasive Surgery in Kochi offers laparoscopic hernia, gallbladder, breast and piles/fistula surgery — with a female surgeon available for patients who prefer one.
data.body:
Kinder Hospital's Department of General & Minimally Invasive Surgery in Kochi provides diagnosis and surgical treatment for the full range of general surgical conditions — hernias, gallstones, appendicitis, thyroid disease, breast lumps, varicose veins, and piles/fistula — using both open and laparoscopic techniques, with a female surgeon available on the team for patients who prefer one.

## A Female Surgeon, Where That Matters to You

For conditions involving breast surgery, hernia repair, or piles and fistula treatment, some patients simply feel more comfortable being examined and treated by a woman — and that's a completely reasonable preference, not something you need to justify or explain. Dr. Saranya Rajendran, a qualified general and laparoscopic surgeon on Kinder's team, is available for consultations and procedures across the full range of general surgery, and you're welcome to specifically request her when booking your appointment.

This isn't a separate, limited service — Dr. Rajendran performs the same range of open and laparoscopic procedures as the rest of the department. It simply means you have a choice, and Kinder's team will always respect it.

Prefer to consult a female surgeon? Let our team know when you book, and we'll arrange your appointment with Dr. Saranya Rajendran.

## Our Approach

Complex surgical problems rarely sit inside one speciality alone, which is why our surgeons work within a multidisciplinary team model — bringing in the right specialists alongside general surgery so that each patient's treatment plan is genuinely comprehensive, not just procedurally correct.

## Why Choose Kinder

- Expert surgical team — Skilled surgeons experienced in both open and laparoscopic techniques, including a female surgeon available by request
- Advanced technology — The latest surgical technology, applied for effective, safer treatment
- Personalised care — Treatment plans built around your specific condition, not a standard protocol
- Faster recovery — Minimally invasive and laparoscopic techniques that mean less discomfort, quicker recovery, and a shorter hospital stay
- Comprehensive support — Continuous care from diagnosis through post-surgical recovery

## Conditions & Procedures We Treat

### General Surgery

- All general surgical procedures
- Major abdominal surgeries, including laparoscopic techniques

### Hernia Surgery

- Open and laparoscopic surgery for all types of hernia

### Gallbladder & Abdominal Conditions

- Laparoscopic surgery for gallbladder stones
- Laparoscopic surgery for appendicitis

### Thyroid & Endocrine Surgery

- Surgery for thyroid and other neck swellings
- Endocrine gland surgeries

### Breast Surgery

- Surgery for breast lumps and breast cancer

Female-surgeon consultation available for breast surgery patients who prefer it — see above.

### Varicose Veins, Piles, Fissure & Fistula

- Laser and other minimally invasive treatment for varicose veins, piles, fissure, and fistula
- Laser treatment for pilonidal sinus
- Dedicated Piles & Fistula Clinic

### Wound & Ulcer Care

- Management of diabetic foot and other chronic ulcers

## Infrastructure

- Ultra-clean operation theatres with laminar airflow and HEPA filtration
- A well-equipped, modern Surgical Intensive Care Unit
- Dedicated Piles & Fistula Clinic for focused, ongoing care

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is a female surgeon available for general surgery at Kinder Hospital, Kochi?

Yes. Dr. Saranya Rajendran, a qualified general and laparoscopic surgeon, is available for consultations and procedures across the full range of general surgery. You can request her specifically when booking your appointment.

### Can I request a female surgeon for a breast lump evaluation?

Yes. You're welcome to request a female surgeon for breast surgery consultations or any other general surgical concern — simply mention this when booking.

### What is minimally invasive (laparoscopic) surgery?

Laparoscopic surgery uses small incisions and a camera to perform procedures that would traditionally require a larger open incision, typically resulting in less pain, a shorter hospital stay, and a faster return to normal activity.

### Is laparoscopic surgery available for hernia and gallbladder problems in Kochi?

Yes. Kinder Hospital's General & Minimally Invasive Surgery department offers laparoscopic surgery for all types of hernia, as well as laparoscopic gallbladder (gallstone) surgery.

### What treatment options exist for piles, fissure, and fistula?

Kinder's dedicated Piles & Fistula Clinic offers laser and other minimally invasive treatments for piles, fissure, and fistula, alongside conventional surgical options depending on severity — with a female surgeon available if you'd prefer one for this consultation.

### How is a diabetic foot ulcer treated?

Diabetic foot and other chronic ulcers are managed through a structured combination of wound care, infection control, and, where needed, surgical intervention — with the goal of preventing complications and supporting healing.

### Does a breast lump always mean cancer?

No — most breast lumps are not cancerous, but any new or unusual lump should be evaluated promptly. Kinder's surgical team manages the full range of breast lumps, including diagnosis and treatment of breast cancer where confirmed.

### How long is the recovery after laparoscopic surgery?

Recovery varies by procedure, but minimally invasive surgery generally involves less post-operative discomfort and a shorter hospital stay compared to open surgery, with many patients returning to routine activity considerably faster.

Book a consultation with Kinder Hospital's General & Minimally Invasive Surgery team, Kochi — request a female surgeon if you'd prefer one.

data.title: Obstetrics & Gynaecology at Kinder Hospital, Kochi
data.excerpt: Kinder Hospital, Kochi offers comprehensive obstetrics and gynaecology care — high-risk pregnancy management, painless labour, Level 3 NICU backup, laparoscopic gynaecology, PCOS/PCOD and fertility care.
data.body:
Kinder Hospital's Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology in Kochi provides comprehensive care for pregnancy and childbirth, high-risk pregnancy management, and the full range of gynaecological conditions — from PCOS and menstrual disorders to laparoscopic surgery and uro-gynaecology — supported by a dedicated Level 3 NICU, 24-hour labour room service, and a multidisciplinary team spanning fetal medicine, reproductive medicine, and gynaecological oncology.

## Obstetric Care

Every pregnancy is different, and our obstetric team is built to support both straightforward deliveries and pregnancies that need closer monitoring — with 24-hour labour room coverage and direct access to Level 3 NICU care if your baby needs it.

- Preconception counselling
- Routine antenatal care and pregnancy monitoring
- Specialist ultrasound by a fetal medicine consultant, including anomaly scans
- Management of high-risk and late pregnancies
- Evaluation and management of recurrent labour complications
- 24-hour labour room service
- Full intrapartum and postpartum care
- Option for painless labour
- Elective and emergency caesarean sections (LSCS)
- Cervical cerclage
- Interval and postpartum sterilisation (laparoscopic)
- ICU and High Dependency Unit (HDU) support for high-risk antepartum and postpartum monitoring
- Full-fledged NICU for pre-term and high-risk babies
- Breastfeeding education and childbirth preparation classes

For a closer look at our labour and delivery environment — including LDRP care, VBAC, and antenatal classes — visit the Premium Birthing Centre page.

## Gynaecology Care

Every diagnosis is shaped by more than one specialist's opinion where needed — a case involving urinary incontinence might bring in our uro-gynaecology specialist; a complex case might draw on reproductive endocrinology or gynaecologic oncology expertise.

- General gynaecology and well-woman visits
- Pre-conception counselling
- Preventive health check-ups
- Menstrual, hormonal and menopausal disorder management
- PCOS / PCOD care, through a dedicated PCOD Clinic
- Uro-gynaecology, including urinary incontinence and pelvic floor dysfunction
- Endometriosis and other chronic gynaecological conditions
- STI/STD diagnosis and treatment
- Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) management
- Evaluation of abnormal Pap smears and pre-malignant conditions such as endometrial dysplasia
- Congenital abnormalities of the female reproductive tract
- Evaluation of sexual function
- Hormone replacement therapy

## Minimally Invasive & Surgical Gynaecology

The choice of procedure depends on diagnosis, medical history, and clinical assessment.

- Laparoscopic hysterectomy (uterus removal)
- Laparoscopic fibroid removal
- Laparoscopic ovarian cyst removal
- Laparoscopy for tubal (ectopic) pregnancy
- Hysteroscopic procedures
- Open hysterectomy, where laparoscopic approach is not clinically appropriate

## Women's Health Clinics

- Well Woman Clinic
- PCOD Clinic
- Menopausal Clinic

## Multidisciplinary Care

Complex cases are rarely confined to one specialty. Depending on clinical need, care is coordinated with Fetomaternal Medicine, Reproductive Medicine, Gynaecological Oncology, Neonatology, Radiology, and Anaesthesiology & Critical Care within Kinder Hospital.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology at Kinder Hospital Kochi treat?

The department covers the full range of pregnancy and childbirth care — including high-risk pregnancy management — alongside gynaecological conditions such as PCOS, menstrual disorders, endometriosis, urinary incontinence, and fibroids, using both medical and minimally invasive surgical treatment where appropriate.

### Does Kinder Hospital Kochi manage high-risk pregnancies?

Yes. Kinder Hospital provides management for high-risk and late pregnancies, supported by ICU and High Dependency Unit monitoring for antepartum and postpartum patients, specialist ultrasound from a fetal medicine consultant, and a full NICU for pre-term or high-risk newborns.

### Is painless labour available at Kinder Hospital?

Yes, the option for painless labour is part of Kinder Hospital's obstetric care, alongside 24-hour labour room service for both planned and emergency deliveries.

### Does Kinder Hospital offer laparoscopic gynaecological surgery?

Yes. Kinder's gynaecology team performs laparoscopic hysterectomy, fibroid removal, ovarian cyst removal, and laparoscopy for tubal pregnancy, along with hysteroscopic procedures — the choice of approach depends on individual diagnosis and clinical assessment.

### Where can I find PCOD/PCOS treatment in Kochi?

Kinder Hospital Kochi has a dedicated PCOD Clinic for the diagnosis and ongoing management of PCOS and related hormonal conditions.

### Does Kinder Hospital provide fetal medicine or anomaly scans?

Yes. Specialist ultrasound, including anomaly scans, is provided by a fetal medicine consultant as part of antenatal care.

### What is uro-gynaecology?

Uro-gynaecology addresses pelvic floor disorders in women, including urinary incontinence and pelvic organ prolapse — conditions at the intersection of gynaecology and urology, treated at Kinder Hospital's Obstetrics & Gynaecology department.

### Does Kinder Hospital Kochi have NICU support for newborns?

Yes, a full NICU is available for pre-term and high-risk babies, working alongside the obstetric team for coordinated maternal and newborn care.

Book a consultation with Kinder Hospital's Obstetrics & Gynaecology team, Kochi.

data.title: Premium Birthing Centre at Kinder Hospital, Kochi
data.excerpt: Kinder Hospital's Premium Birthing Centre in Kochi offers LDRP suites, VBAC, painless labour, birth-companion support and antenatal classes, in a home-like maternity setting.
data.body:
Kinder Hospital's Premium Birthing Centre in Kochi is a dedicated maternity space combining LDRP (Labour, Delivery, Recovery, Postpartum) suites, painless labour, VBAC for eligible mothers, and birth-companion support in a home-like environment — designed around the belief that every birth is different, even for the same mother twice over.

## A Birth Experience Built Around You

Located in the prime location of Kochi, the Premium Birthing Centre was built on a simple philosophy: choice. From the healthcare provider a mother feels most comfortable with, to how she chooses to labour and deliver, the Centre combines regular antenatal check-ups with group support and structured education — because no two births are the same, even for the same woman.

The Centre offers a more home-like environment than a typical hospital labour ward, with more options during labour and space for family to be part of the experience — contributing to a positive, supported birthing journey.

- Massage therapy and relaxation support
- Antenatal classes and antenatal yoga
- A Pregnancy Club connecting expecting mothers
- Baby shower and milestone-day celebrations
- Personalised care from experienced gynaecologists and nursing staff
- Comfortable, well-equipped birthing suites opening onto private postpartum rooms

## LDRP: One Room, Every Stage of Birth

Kinder's LDRP (Labour, Delivery, Recovery, Postpartum) facility lets a mother stay in one room through her entire childbirth journey — no transfers between wards at the moments that matter most. The suite is staffed round-the-clock by experienced obstetricians, gynaecologists, and nursing staff, and equipped with advanced medical technology for pain management, fetal monitoring, and neonatal care.

Loved ones are welcome to stay close throughout labour and delivery, offering emotional support and helping create a more positive childbirth experience. Postpartum, care continues seamlessly with breastfeeding support, newborn care, and structured recovery services — alongside educational programmes covering breastfeeding, infant care, and maternal health.

Painless delivery options are available for mothers who want them, helping ease anxiety around the pain of childbirth.

## VBAC — Vaginal Birth After Caesarean

For eligible mothers who have had a previous caesarean delivery, Kinder Hospital offers VBAC as a safe, well-supported option. VBAC is a personal decision, made after careful consideration of individual circumstances — our obstetric team works closely with each patient to assess eligibility based on medical history and current health, and to guide the decision with clarity and support.

Advanced monitoring technology and an experienced clinical team ensure both mother and baby are closely and continuously cared for throughout.

Water birth is available at Kinder through a dedicated Water Birthing Suite — see the Water Birthing Centre page for eligibility, safety protocols, and hydrotherapy pain-relief options for mothers not delivering in water.

## Who the Birthing Centre Is For

- Mothers planning their full antenatal and delivery care at Kinder Hospital, Kochi
- Expectant mothers looking for structured antenatal education and pregnancy support
- Mothers interested in LDRP care and birth-companion support
- Eligible mothers considering VBAC after individual obstetric assessment
- Families wanting maternity care connected directly to specialist pregnancy and newborn services

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is included in Kinder Hospital's Premium Birthing Centre?

The Centre combines LDRP suites, painless labour options, VBAC for eligible mothers, birth-companion support, antenatal classes and yoga, and postnatal Ayurveda care, in a home-like maternity environment.

### What does LDRP mean?

LDRP stands for Labour, Delivery, Recovery and Postpartum — a model where a mother receives care through all four stages in a single room, without being moved between wards.

### Can I have a VBAC (vaginal birth after caesarean) at Kinder Hospital?

VBAC may be an option for eligible mothers who have had a previous caesarean delivery. Eligibility is assessed individually by the obstetric team, based on medical history and current maternal and fetal health.

### Is painless delivery available at the Birthing Centre?

Yes, painless delivery options are part of Kinder's Birthing Centre services, alongside the LDRP model of continuous, one-room labour and delivery care.

### Can my partner or family be present during labour?

Yes. Kinder's Birthing Centre includes Birth Companion support, allowing a loved one to stay close through labour and delivery for emotional support.

### Does Kinder Hospital offer water birth?

Yes, through a dedicated Water Birthing Suite — the first of its kind in Kerala. See the Water Birthing Centre page for eligibility and safety details.

### Does the Birthing Centre provide antenatal classes?

Yes. Antenatal classes, antenatal yoga, and specialist pregnancy diet guidance are part of the Birthing Centre's antenatal support programme.

Begin your journey with us — book a consultation with Kinder Hospital's maternity team, Kochi.

data.title: Water Birth at Kinder Hospital, Kochi
data.excerpt: Considering a water birth in Kochi? Kinder Hospital's Water Birthing Suite — Kerala's first — offers natural, low-intervention labour and delivery, with expert monitoring throughout. Check your eligibility and enquire today.
data.body:
Kinder Hospital's Water Birthing Suite in Kochi is Kerala's first dedicated water birthing facility, offering eligible mothers the option to labour and deliver in a warm-water birthing pool, with continuous monitoring and an experienced maternity team throughout. Mothers not delivering in water can also use the suite for hydrotherapy pain relief during labour.

Ready to find out if a water birth is right for you? Book a consultation with our maternity team — contact our care team.

## Why Consider a Water Birth

- Reduced contraction pain, with the body's own endorphins providing natural relief
- Lower likelihood of needing pain-relief medication such as pethidine or an epidural
- Reduced need for labour-accelerating drugs like oxytocin
- Often a shorter labour
- A greater sense of control and empowerment through the process
- Buoyancy that conserves energy and eases the physical strain of labour
- A relaxed pelvic floor and softer perineum, lowering the risk of tearing
- A gentler entry into the world for your baby

## Are You Eligible for a Water Birth? Check Now

Water birth is generally suitable for healthy mothers with a normal, uncomplicated pregnancy who go into established labour naturally. You may be eligible if:

- Your body weight is under 100 kg
- Your baby is confirmed in a head-down position
- You're in good general health, and able to exit the pool quickly if needed
- Your vital signs — blood pressure, temperature, and pulse — are within normal range
- Your labour is progressing naturally, without need for IV medication to strengthen contractions

Not sure if you qualify? That's exactly what a consultation is for — our maternity team will assess your eligibility individually as your pregnancy progresses.

Check your eligibility with our maternity team — enquire today.

## Inside the Kinder Water Birthing Suite

Kinder's Water Birthing Suite is designed as a peaceful, spa-like space, built to international safety benchmarks in maternity care.

- Purpose-built pools — Premium birthing pools — deep, spacious, ergonomically designed tubs, temperature-controlled for safety and comfort throughout labour
- Precisely controlled temperature — Water maintained between 36.5°C and 37°C through the first stage of labour, raised to 37.5°C for delivery, with hourly checks on maternal, water, and room temperature
- Hygiene & infection control — Single-use tub liners, thorough cleaning protocols, and controlled water levels to prevent contamination or overheating
- Birth partner access — A birth partner of your choice is welcome throughout — including, if desired, taking an active role in the birth itself
- Continuous safety monitoring — Intermittent fetal monitoring and regular checks on maternal vitals, even while labouring in water

## Hydrotherapy — Pain Relief, Even Without a Water Birth

Water immersion is a well-evidenced pain-relief tool in its own right, independent of whether you choose to deliver in water. Many mothers at Kinder use the birthing pool purely for pain management during labour, stepping out to deliver conventionally — it pairs well with breathing and relaxation techniques, massage, or gas and air (Entonox).

If stronger pain relief is needed — a pethidine injection or an epidural — you'll need to leave the pool, and re-entry is restricted for four hours after a pain-relieving injection. A Cochrane review has confirmed the benefits of water immersion in the first stage of labour, showing reduced analgesia use and lower reported pain, with no adverse effect on labour duration, delivery outcomes, or newborn health.

## Is Water Birth Safe?

For healthy mothers with an uncomplicated, full-term pregnancy, complications during water labour are rare. The most common concern — a baby inhaling water — is highly unlikely, thanks to natural physiological reflexes: the temperature change at birth itself suppresses the breathing reflex, and your baby's head is kept fully submerged until it clears the water, delaying that first breath until it's safe to take. Water temperature is monitored throughout to avoid any sudden change, adding a further layer of safety on top of these natural safeguards.

You're free to leave the pool at any point during labour if you change your mind — the one exception is once your baby's head is about to be born. You may need to leave the pool for:

- A toilet break
- Difficulty monitoring your baby's heart rate, or any irregularities detected
- A vaginal examination, if your team requests you step out for it
- Abnormal blood pressure, pulse, or temperature
- Labour not progressing as expected
- Delivering the placenta, after birth

## What Happens Next — Your First Step

Considering a water birth doesn't commit you to anything. Here's how most mothers get started:

- 1. Enquire — Book a consultation with our maternity team, at any stage of your pregnancy
- 2. Discuss your eligibility — We'll review your health, your pregnancy so far, and answer every question you have — including ones not covered on this page
- 3. Reassess closer to delivery — As your due date nears, your eligibility is reconfirmed based on how your pregnancy and labour are progressing
- 4. Labour, your way — On the day, our team supports you in the birthing suite, with the flexibility to adapt your plan if your labour calls for it

Talk to our maternity team about water birth — contact our care team today.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is water birth safe for the baby?

For healthy, full-term pregnancies, water birth carries a very low complication rate. A baby's natural reflexes — including breathing-reflex suppression triggered by the temperature change at birth — make water inhalation highly unlikely, and staff keep the baby's head submerged until it clears the water as an added safeguard.

### Who is eligible for a water birth?

Generally, healthy mothers with an uncomplicated pregnancy, a baby in the head-down position, body weight under 100 kg, normal vital signs, and labour progressing naturally without medical augmentation. Final eligibility is confirmed individually by our maternity team.

### Is water birth painful compared to a normal delivery?

Many mothers report less contraction pain during water labour, due to the buoyancy and relaxation the water provides, along with the body's own increased endorphin production. It doesn't eliminate labour pain entirely, but often reduces the need for medical pain relief.

### What's the difference between water birth and hydrotherapy during labour?

Water birth means labouring and delivering in the pool. Hydrotherapy means using the pool for pain relief during labour only, then stepping out to deliver conventionally. Both are available at Kinder Hospital, and you can decide — or change your mind — as labour progresses.

### Can I still get an epidural if I'm in the birthing pool?

If you need stronger pain relief such as a pethidine injection or an epidural, you'll need to leave the pool, and you won't be able to re-enter for four hours after a pain-relieving injection.

### Is Kinder Hospital's water birthing suite the only one in Kerala?

Kinder Hospital's Water Birthing Suite is Kerala's first dedicated facility of its kind.

### How do I know if a water birth is right for me?

The best way to find out is a consultation with our maternity team, who can assess your eligibility based on your specific pregnancy and health — you're welcome to enquire at any stage of pregnancy, even if you're not sure yet.

### Can my partner be with me during a water birth?

Yes. A birth partner of your choice is welcome throughout, and can take an active role in the birth if you'd like.

Still deciding? Talk to our maternity team — there's no commitment, just answers. Contact our care team.
